group.label: Cross-links settings
group.comment: Configure how cross-linking behaves across your site content to enhance internal linking structure.

field.label: Allowed areas for cross-links
field.comment: Select specific content areas where cross-links should be automatically inserted. Limiting to relevant areas improves page load performance.

field.label: Restrict link placement in tags
field.comment: Specify HTML tags where links should not be inserted (e.g., h1, h2, a, strong). Enter one tag per line without brackets.

field.label: Prevent adding cross-links on pages
field.comment: Enter URL patterns (one per line) where cross-links should be disabled. Use * as wildcard (e.g., catalog/product/* or */checkout).

field.label: Template paths for link insertion
field.comment: Specify template file paths (one per line) where links should be inserted. Note: Processing will fail for templates exceeding 1000 HTML tags due to memory constraints.

field.label: Max number of links per page
field.comment: Set maximum number of auto-generated cross-links per page. Lower values may improve page load time and prevent over-optimization.

field.label: Avoid duplicate URLs in cross-links
field.comment: When enabled, if multiple keywords point to the same URL, only the first occurrence will be linked. This prevents duplicate links and improves page load performance.
